review_comments.body:
** Minor** · **Performance & Scalability** · **Quick win** **Bound the error-body read before formatting the message.** If an endpoint returns a large error body, `AsString()` reads the entire body into memory. In commons v1.62.0, this method uses unrestricted `io.ReadAll`. Later error truncation does not limit this allocation. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flanksource/commons/v1.62.0/http/response.go)) Read a bounded prefix with `io.LimitReader`, and close the response body after the read. Keep the status in the error message.
